question: SPUR is related to WTYV in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, PMRO is related to TQVS. To which of the following is IFKH related, following the same logic ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'SPUR' is related to 'WTYV'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9596ad392d728996108353ba887da8138a84f2c979dfbadced7f18384ee9227b.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8bd7c8d69a8b3e63f0fa11b8bda15a93cba8f76426e8aeb16b8e46ef1341725e.png] 

'PMRO' is related to 'TQVS'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6f2ff9bcdcfe579f50a12d9c246af47d8d5125085ea2897317dcc0f3373de981.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1c503ab28e5307cc4ee583d1c3db2e260fe1521b597fab194e834aa5ea108b7d.png] 

Similarly, for 'IFKH'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6084c561dee8a5a0777bc0295215ad584405a5c6361cd3b1b7e8f18cdd1f896d.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8928d27f20527e23a31e5c59092a1944af0d8d47a5691bd5c9944b97a78acde4.png] 

So, 'IFKH' is related to '**MJOL**'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.
